integrity: Analytic proof gives an all-parameter lower bound and matching projection; finite exact rational tests are supplemental. No independent scientific verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real two-dimensional four-coordinate realization; uniqueness only for coordinate-swap-equivariant projections and 0<t<1. Interior Banach–Mazur distance is bounded, not computed exactly. Historical equivalences under general planar projection-constant terminology remain possible.
title: Sharp projection constants for a symmetric four-coordinate deformation
